Google Antigravity CLI Agent – Google Drops Free Antigravity AI Coding Agent for Developers

Google Antigravity is a completely free AI coding agent offering local terminal integration, multi-agent orchestrations, and full Gemini 4 Argon model access. Discover why developers are switching from paid tools.

Designed for developers and engineering teams, Google Antigravity CLI Agent accelerates implementation, eliminates repetitive development friction, and streamlines day-to-day coding workflows.

Key Features:
• Download and install Google Antigravity CLI.
• Authenticate with your Google account via agy auth.
• Run agy build to scaffold full-stack applications with built-in agent review.
• Scaffolded TypeScript repository with passing test suite and automated Docker build.

Official Website: https://antigravity.google/
Instagram Breakdown: https://www.instagram.com/p/DZcoSPltyzE/
